reasons: Directionally correct: Section 6.11 is the only audit right running against our client (AbbVie as licensee/payor); the Article 3 inspection rights run in our favour, so the finding correctly scopes the rule to 6.11.

On its material terms the clause satisfies the preferred position: audit limited to books and records supporting Net Sales/royalty reports (no access to our systems), frequency capped ('not ... more than once in any [***] period'), performed by an independent nationally recognized accounting firm reasonably acceptable to us, auditor may report only correctness plus specific discrepancies, and Harpoon bears cost unless a stated variance threshold is exceeded; 6.13 imposes a confidentiality undertaking in our favour. Nothing approaches walk-away (no unlimited, unannounced or remote-access audits).

The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is explained by the [***] redaction of the period rather than an absent cap — the limiting sentence is present, so the heuristic is not probative here.

Treating the redacted frequency period, notice period and variance percentage as a parameter confirmation item rather than a deviation is the correct handling; a missing express notice period is a minor sub-element to note in the rationale, not a fallback breach on the visible terms.
Consistent with a compliant claim, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and the paragraphs are rendered unchanged, so there is no over-flagging or invalid edit to correct.
